content.title: Review & Preview: Lackluster Jobs, Lively Market
content.summary: Wall Street cheered a lower unemployment rate, even though the December jobs figure missed expectations.  The Nasdaq Composite rallied 0.8%.  At 4.4%, the unemployment rate still came in below the expected 4.5%, and November’s figure was revised lower to 4.5%.

content.title: Heard on the Street Recap: Record Highs Again
content.summary: The U.S. economy added a seasonally adjusted 50,000 jobs in December, the Labor Department said.  The unemployment rate ticked down to 4.4%.  The report caps a weak year for hiring and clears the way for the Federal Reserve to hold rates steady at its late-January meeting.

content.title: These Stocks Moved the Most Today: Oklo, Vistra, Opendoor, Intel, GM, Revolution Medicines, Tilray, and More
content.summary: Stocks rose Friday after fresh jobs data showed U.S. unemployment ticked down in December and a potential Supreme Court ruling on tariffs failed to pan out.  Vistra  stock surged 11% and  Oklo  jumped 7.9% after the nuclear energy companies unveiled separate agreements to provide power to  Meta Platforms  in order to support the hyperscaler’s data-center campus in Ohio.  Meta inched up 1.1%.
